source: Illustration only: with a 2027 determining average annual income of CHF 46,080 and 44 of 44 credited contribution years, the estimated full monthly pension is CHF 1,946. From 2026, a qualifying old-age pension is paid 13 times per year; this scenario assumes the pension is payable for all 12 months.
